description: Account number field stored as int64 but intended to be a 4‑character string. Contains 30 records with no missing values, values range from 1001 to 1028, and is near‑unique with two duplicate values (1001, 1010).
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert integer values to 4‑character string representations, e.g., 1026 → "1026" (applies to 100% of rows).
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values conform to a 4‑digit numeric string format, e.g., "1026".
[CLARIFY] Verify whether duplicate account numbers ("1001", "1010") are permissible or should be unique.
